cards.title: Business problem
cards.subtitle: Manufacturing Yield, Scrap & Quality Cockpit
cards.description: Manufacturing operations must balance production output, yield, scrap, rework and product quality. When production confirmations, goods movements, inspection results and quality notifications are analysed separately, managers may struggle to understand where losses occur and which plant, shift, work centre, supplier lot or batch requires attention.
